#1 JURY ROOM. ROY GORDET JUDGE PRO TEM.CLERK E. MONTI 2:35 PM C/C FOR SETTL CONF. PLTF PRESENT WITH COUNSEL KURT HUYSENRUYT; DEFT PRESENT IN PRO PER. STIPULATED JUDGMENT READ INTO THE RECORD AS FOLLOWS: PLTF TO HAVE IMMEDIATE JUDGMENT FOR POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES LOCATED AT 603 MISSISSIPPI ST, S.F. WRIT MAY ISSUE IMMEDIATELY BUT EXECUTION STAYED TILL NOV 30,1993. BOTH PARTIES AGREED THAT AMOUNT OF RENT OWED IS $4,200.00. IF DEFT VACATES THE PREMISES PLTF WILL WAIVE THE RENT AND REFUND THE $700.00 SECURITY DEPOSIT UPON RECEIPT OF THE KEYS. IF DEFT FAILS TO VACATE DEFT TO PAY THE AMOUNT DUE. PLTF WILL APPLY THE $700.00 SECURITY DEPOSIT TO THE RENT, SO TOTAL AMOUNT DUE THEN IS $3,500.00. ANY PERSONAL PROPERTY LEFT DEEMED ABANDONED. EACH SIDE TO BEAR OWN COSTS AND ATTY FEES. PLTF TO PREPARE STIP AND MAIL TO DEFT FOR SIGNATURE. IF DEFT FAILS TO RETURN SIGNED STIP TO PLTF, PLTF TO MAIL UNSIGNED STIP TO COURT FOR ENTRY.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HUDINA, CHUCK THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 603 MISSISSIPPI ST. SF, STAYED UNTIL NOV-30-1993, LEASE FORFEITED, PARTIES AGREE THAT $4200.00 IS OWED. IF DEFT VACATES PREMISES ON OR BEFORE 11-30-93, PLTF WAIVES PAYMENT OF RENT. IF DEFT DOES NOT VACATE ON OR BEFORE 11-30-93, JUDGMENT SHALL BE FOR $4200.00. IF DEFT VACATES ON OR BEFORE 11-30-93, PLTF TO REFUND SEC. DEP. OF $700.00.
